svg.title: Review: diffraction - change the wavelength
svg.desc: Same opening width and same scale. A shorter wavelength of 0.5 units and a longer wavelength of 1 unit pass through the same opening of width 2 units. The longer wavelength spreads more.
svg.text: Same opening. Longer wavelength: greater angular spreading.
The incoming wavefront spacing changes; the opening width stays the same.
